item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Separate naming directions from wording variants","mechanism":"Organize suggestions by their stated rationale and addressed constraints, not just textual similarity or early attention.","implementation":"Add rationale and constraint fields. Let contributors create direction lanes and place a suggestion in multiple lanes without duplicating it.","check":"Submit “Oak Commons” for tree identity and “Oak Common” for shared stewardship; verify both directions remain visible.","risk":"Mandatory categorization could discourage tentative ideas; allow unclassified submissions."},{"action":"Reopen rejections when their constraints change","mechanism":"Bind each rejection to explicit, versioned constraints so its applicability can be checked after edits.","implementation":"Store rejection explanations with constraint versions. When a referenced constraint changes, mark the rejection “needs reconsideration” and notify reviewers without automatically accepting the name.","check":"Reject a name for exceeding two words; relax that limit and verify the rejection becomes reviewable with its original explanation intact.","risk":"Broad constraint edits may generate excessive reconsideration notices."},{"action":"Show hard-constraint conflicts independently of popularity","mechanism":"Keep hard-constraint violations visible without selecting a winner or suppressing the violating suggestion.","implementation":"Give constraints hard or advisory status. Attach pass, fail, or unknown assessments with evidence to names; retain contested assessments and record constraint edits.","check":"Give a popular name three words under a two-word hard limit; verify its conflict remains visible despite support.","risk":"Subjective constraints need human assessment rather than automatic failure."},{"action":"Protect authorship during anonymous first review","mechanism":"Separate private attribution records from review content and withhold identity until each reviewer submits their first assessment.","implementation":"Store author IDs behind restricted access. Serve anonymous review payloads without author metadata, avatars, or attribution history; make later disclosure explicit.","check":"Inspect first-review responses and exports for identity leaks; verify authorized custodians can still recover original authorship.","risk":"Distinctive rationale wording may reveal identity despite metadata protection."},{"action":"Give late alternatives a fresh-review queue","mechanism":"Allocate attention by review coverage rather than popularity, ensuring late suggestions receive an independent reading.","implementation":"Maintain an explicit unreviewed queue with round-robin presentation. Hide support totals during first review; require a linked earlier suggestion and rationale comparison for “already considered.”","check":"Add a late, similar-sounding name addressing a new constraint; verify it enters review and cannot be dismissed with an unlinked duplicate label.","risk":"Queue obligations may slow large sessions; permit visible deferral."},{"action":"Make every grouping reversible and traceable","mechanism":"Treat groups as references to intact suggestions rather than replacements that erase distinctions or attribution.","implementation":"Preserve immutable submission records and edit history. Record group membership changes; provide expandable originals and undoable split operations, respecting private-authorship permissions.","check":"Group two similar names, edit the group label, then split it; verify original wording, rationales, IDs, and authorized authorship remain recoverable.","risk":"Large histories can clutter the interface; collapse them by default."},{"action":"Keep unresolved dissent beside team shortlists","mechanism":"Preserve objections as structured open issues rather than letting a shortlist imply unanimous agreement.","implementation":"Attach objections to names or directions with the disputed constraint, explanation, and resolution status. Show unresolved issues beside shortlists; require recorded reasons for closure and allow reopening.","check":"Shortlist a popular name with an unresolved hard-constraint objection; verify the objection stays visible and closure preserves its history.","risk":"Repeated objections can overwhelm discussion; link duplicates without deleting originals."}],"abstention_reason":""}
